statement: The proportion of SUID cases with recorded pregnancy weight gain differs between NCFR-P v5.1 and PRAMS Phase 8 ARF.
rationale: This design compares how the same concept (pregnancy weight gain) is measured differently across two distinct sources (NCFR-P case series vs. PRAMS population reference).
prior_art: The manuscripts have not addressed the comparability or differences in recording pregnancy weight gain between case series and population reference datasets, which could influence risk factor analysis for SUID.
cannot_establish: incidence or risk, only proportions among cases.
